record: R117_F30_PREREG_AMENDMENT_1/1.1.0 (Art. 4 additive amendment, PRE-GENERATION — typed timing disclosure)
claim: c-0169 (amends the F30 prereg of claim c-0168, eval/r116_f30_bind_value_prereg.json)
timing_disclosure: ZERO F30 generation bytes exist (verified this window: the arms' output tree eval/r116_f30_run/ has never been created; no bare or engine call has been made; the v1.0.0 preflight was deterministic zero-LLM). This amendment lands BEFORE any generation call — a lawful prereg amendment per Art. 9, not post-hoc tuning (the prereg's own anti-tuning clause types post-generation changes as findings; this is the pre-generation design-fix class, disclosed).

the_finding.severity: DESIGN DEFECT in the v1.0.0 set (self-caught, Art. 5): the seeded and healthy items' PROMPT-RELEVANT BYTES ARE IDENTICAL (failure/constraint/text equal in all 12 pairs; only problem_id and the sealed key's canonical answers differ). The v1.0.0 mutation strategy embedded the defect in the canonical ANSWERS (proving the BINDS can catch such answers — the preflight's real function), but the generation arms write their OWN answers from the problem text, so both arms would see byte-identical problems and the seeded/healthy distinction could not manifest. The run as preregistered v1.0.0 would be uninformative — exactly the saturated-corpus waste class the R116 verdict condemned.
the_finding.the_fix: EMBED the proposal under review in the problem bytes: each item's question field now carries a DRAFT PROPOSAL (the v1.0.0 canonical answer text, verbatim) and asks for a review verdict. The seeded item's draft IS the defective proposal (the seeded defect now lives in the problem bytes the arms actually read); the healthy twin's draft is the clean proposal. The arms' task: 'review this draft proposal against the constraint' — the bare arm sees only the problem text; the engine arm runs the same problem through the frozen machine's bind battery + the repair loop. The defect classes, the sealed key, the catch/false-alarm definitions, the arms' generator identity, the bootstrap and the Art. 14-mapped gates are UNCHANGED.

the_amendment.item_shape: each item carries: problem_id, device, failure (the failure description, full sentences), question (the review directive + the DRAFT PROPOSAL verbatim), question_type='draft-review', constraint (the permitted-measures/constraint span the binds read — unchanged fields), user_variables, seeded flag ONLY in the sealed key (never in the item bytes the arms read beyond the item_id suffix; the -h/-s suffix stays in item_id for scoring bookkeeping — the arms cannot see the key)

the_arms.bare: agnes-3.0-flash, ONE call per item: the problem JSON (the same bytes the engine arm's generator prompt carries, the machine's own _gen_fb transport) + a minimal review directive; the answer is the raw completion
the_arms.engine: the frozen machine path: machine_generate_v79 (r97's frozen V7.9 challenger loop with all five binds + the repair loop, the v15 one-shot machine byte-unchanged) on the SAME problem bytes — the binds scan the machine's OWN draft/repair outputs and the final delivery carries the bind findings

scoring.caught_defect_engine: the machine's final_meta carries the defect class as a bind finding on the seeded item (residual OR repaired — a repair that quotes and fixes the defect counts as CAUGHT: the machine's own record demonstrates it saw the defect), OR the delivered answer's final text declines/corrects the seeded defect (the same deterministic class detector as the preflight, applied to the delivered text)
scoring.caught_defect_bare: the bare answer's own text names/declines/corrects the seeded defect (the deterministic detector + the ONE judge-family call on the detector's DISAGREEMENT class only — the R6 pattern: the judge sees problem+draft+answer, never the arm label)
scoring.false_alarm: any bind finding of the item's defect class (or a defect-adjacent decline) on a HEALTHY item; healthy drafts are clean by construction (the v1.0.0 canonical healthy answers, preflight-verified silent)
scoring.primary: CATCH_RATE per arm over the 12 seeded items, paired by item; engine-minus-bare paired percentile bootstrap 10k, seed 117
scoring.secondary: FALSE_ALARM_RATE per arm over the 12 healthy items; the engine gate <= 0.25 (Art. 14 feasibility number, Art. 9 labelled assumption with the sensitivity path = the per-bind false-alarm table)

the_amendment.acceptance_branches: UNCHANGED from v1.0.0: engine catch-rate CI excludes 0 above bare AND engine false-alarm <= 0.25 -> bind value PROVEN; CI covers 0 or false-alarm > 0.25 -> typed negative + the bind-retirement question to the auditor WITH the false-alarm curve; NO score claims from this instrument
the_amendment.quota_budget: re-estimated honestly from the v15 attestation (157 gateway calls for 30 rows through the full machine with repairs): the F30 engine arm carries 24 items with the machine's repair budget -> ~100-130 calls worst case; the bare arm 24; the judge <= 6; TOTAL ~130-160 on the 2-key rotation (higher than the v1.0.0 ~48 estimate, which under-priced the machine's repair loop; disclosed). Wall-tolerant: byte-skip resume per item per arm, the r67s2 rotation with typed 429 backoff; if the wall hits mid-run the partial rows stay committed and the run resumes next window (never a second generation per item per arm, Art. 29(c))
the_amendment.leakage_controls: the sealed key never enters any prompt; both arms receive byte-identical problem JSON; the judge never sees the arm label; the deterministic detector is the committed preflight's own logic; the machine's repair directive quotes its own bind findings (never the key)

invalidates: the v1.0.0 items.jsonl generation shape ONLY (the set is REGENERATED as v1.1.0 with the draft embedded; the 12 defect classes, key spans and canonical answers are UNCHANGED — the v1.0.0 preflight verdicts remain valid for the bind-catchability proof). The prereg's instrument design, metrics, gates and acceptance branches are otherwise unchanged. The v1.0.0 items.jsonl stays in git history (never silently rewritten, Art. 4).
